title: Test actual covalent products and restored ends before a full manifold
statement: The44000USD proposal compares independently authenticated unextended, correct, mismatched, base-matched-wrong-side-group and oxidized variants, pauses two programs by omitting a common monomer, then restores it in the same vessel without replacing initiators. It measures actual products, retained stock, enzyme carryover and primer damage, with thresholds such as>=99%resumption and>=99.5%correct ready ends. It is unexecuted; a right-base/wrong-side-group advance remains a specificity limitation. Passing would not establish the20step library, optical contrast, full24h service or cost advantage.
